micro_frontends: auth, dashboard, navigation-drawer, root-config, statement, transactions

justification_pt: Dashboard and statement are mounted on different routes and not simultaneously active, so there are no duplicated requests for the same data.
Auth is a feature MFE with a complete authentication domain, not merely a UI component; having one screen does not make it a nano frontend.
No MFE is imported by all others; compositions.json is empty, and communication occurs via events, not direct imports.
